title: Counter sign-in
summary: Who is billing, and for which shop. Proves the person and binds the counter to one shop.
raised_by: Athi's report, 2026-09-28: signed in to another shop and still saw shop X's products

map.title: Counter sign-in
map.note: Proves the person, binds the counter to one shop.

map.title: Shop gate
map.note: becomeShop(): the only code that changes the shop.

map.title: Shop switch
map.note: Browser and shop PC, on the real program.

entries.d: The one door on the header. The signin engine decides what it opens: sign in, hand over, or unlock.
Locks with the bill kept; unlock opens the one sign-in, straight to the PIN of whoever locked it.
Tapping a name no longer signs anybody in. It opens the sign-in for that person: their PIN, or their user ID.
A break is a lock; coming back is a sign-in.
After the quiet minutes the counter locks itself, the same way the 🔒 pill does.
The device door, after a key is refused. Opens the same dialog, marked to replace the key.
Opening the counter from the back office hands over a key in the address.
A pasted key. Used to repaint in place; now reloads through the shop gate.

process.d: The one place a person proves who they are, on both kinds of counter.
The rules: which door, what a PIN is, when to stop trusting it. Pure, tested alone (38 checks).
Compares the person's shop with the counter's. Another shop means a switch, or nobody signs in.

process.s: G1 · the only writer of the key
process.d: Stores the key, keeps the old shop's copy, then reloads (browser) or restarts (shop PC).
Checks the counter PIN on the device. No network call.
The same person carries on; anyone else is a shift change. Lifts the lock and ends a break.
Sends the code, proves the person (now with their shop), issues the counter key.
Holds the key on the PC side, enrols with the page's session, restarts into the shop's folder.

exits.d: The name on every bill. Written only by the person gate.
Which shop this counter bills for. Written only by the shop gate.

exits.s: IndexedDB per key · PC folder per shop
exits.d: Products, bills, queue, parked bills. Never touched when switching; the queue is money.
Never the PIN itself. Per shop, per person, separate from their online PIN.
Survives a reload. The shop sees "on break".

exits.t: Reload or restart into the shop
exits.d: The start-up path is the only code that opens a shop, so nothing carries across.

PIN rules, lockout after 5, the unlock door, offline doors
another shop's sign-in switches the whole counter, or nobody signs in
shop PC: first sign-in, switch by restart, parked bills stay with their shop, engine versions reported
PIN sign-in with the line down, no network call, lockout, picker asks for proof
lock keeps the bill, keys do nothing behind it, unlock, break, auto-lock
a refused key is replaced on "sign in again"
a counter number held elsewhere is asked about; leaving it is the default
a break reaches the shop and survives a reload
